tasks.short: Collaborate on environmental science teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Locate current environmental science course, laboratory or research issue sources
inputs: actual colleague's teaching/research issue
actual current course or research records
outputs: located current issue sources

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues on actual teaching/research choices and capture actual working notes
inputs: located current issue sources
actual colleague perspectives and discussion
outputs: actual collaborative choices, disagreements and teacher-captured working notes

steps.what: Write assigned collaborative recommendations and follow-up from actual working notes
inputs: actual collaborative choices, disagreements and teacher-captured working notes
outputs: complete source-linked collaborative follow-up draft

loop.purpose: Draft assigned follow-up from actual checked collaboration notes
loop.input: teacher-captured choices, dissent, actual owners and agreed actions
loop.output: source-linked follow-up draft with missing assignments left explicit
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, omitted disagreement, invented consensus and whether each recommendation/action was actually chosen
loop.stop: Unclear decision or two failed revisions returns affected text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native action fields first; varied technical recommendations need semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Complete and check actual written recommendations and retain the internal follow-up record
inputs: complete source-linked collaborative follow-up draft
actual collaborative choices, disagreements and teacher-captured working notes
outputs: checked saved actual collaborative recommendations and follow-up

tasks.design: Configure current issue-source links in {DOCS}/{PROJECT}, then draft only actually assigned follow-up from teacher-captured working notes. Retain collaboration, substantive decisions and complete written checks; ordinary internal saving is ungated with no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Issue-source navigation and descriptive follow-up typing can repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and bounded note-grounded drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Research and teaching choices require real colleague judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher preserves a scientific disagreement that changes the next action.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation and descriptive follow-up typing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: note-grounded drafting can assist actual collaborative follow-up while technical choices and meaning checks remain human.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three locating points and draft20 removes four descriptive typing points after retained review. Actual note capture is counted within55, not a free transcript. Formal follow-up is only included if actually assigned; remove/reweight otherwise.

Course/research owners supply actual source id/version and status; teacher records actual decisions, dissent and assignments during discussion. Missing context is clarified manually. Existing links/templates receive no credit. Shared internal workspace is the actual delivery route here, without invented extra email or approval work.
unknowns: Does this teacher own the actual written collaborative follow-up?
research_questions: Can draft follow-up preserve disagreement and avoid inventing assignments?

incremental.description: Maintain issue-source links and follow-up meaning checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation plus4 descriptive typing points minus0.9 upkeep=6.1. Low: a new joint laboratory problem needs fresh technical recommendations, leaving only2 familiar source-navigation points and0.5 descriptive typing points removable, minus0.9=1.6. Collaboration, capture and full written checks retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and deliver environmental science lectures.

steps.what: Choose hazardous-waste, industrial-safety or environmental-toxicology lecture objectives and accurate examples
inputs: actual curriculum and learner needs
actual current subject evidence
outputs: chosen lecture objectives, sources and examples

steps.what: Prepare lectures by assembling selected subject diagrams, explanations and exercises
inputs: chosen lecture objectives, sources and examples
actual current selected lecture sections
outputs: complete environmental science lecture draft

steps.what: Check whole lecture for actual subject accuracy and retain the final internal material
inputs: complete environmental science lecture draft
chosen lecture objectives, sources and examples
outputs: checked saved final environmental science lecture

steps.what: Deliver lectures to actual undergraduate or graduate students and answer questions
inputs: checked saved final environmental science lecture
actual students and questions
outputs: actual lecture delivery and learner responses

steps.what: Write and check actual assigned lecture observations and follow-up notes
inputs: actual lecture delivery and learner responses
outputs: checked saved actual lecture follow-up notes

tasks.design: Configure reuse of selected current lecture sections and diagrams in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Keep subject/example selection, actual adaptation, complete accuracy checks, lecture delivery and assigned fresh follow-up notes; ordinary internal saves receive no saving or self-gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable subject diagrams and lecture sections can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native selected-section reuse can remove assembly without choosing scientific explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Learners need accurate explanation of hazards, dose/response and uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher identifies a misunderstanding that would lead to unsafe interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Less lecture assembly; teaching decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected lecture-section reuse can reduce preparation while technical accuracy and actual teaching remain human.

assumptions: Provisional preparation30 removes nine stable section/diagram assembly points; twenty-one actual adaptation points remain, plus full final checks10. Existing reuse receives zero new credit. Material/source owners supply actual section revision, subject source, units and applicability; missing/current content is prepared manually.

Teacher supplies real learner observations after delivery; follow-up notes only if actually assigned, otherwise drop/reweight. No competence inferred from attendance and no separate material send or grade transfer invented. Ordinary saves stay in retained checking/record time.
unknowns: Which subject sections are already reused and which need current updates?
research_questions: Can reuse preserve current hazard/toxicology qualifications rather than copying obsolete examples?

incremental.description: Maintain lecture-section sources, units and revision applicability.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes9 repeat lecture-assembly points minus0.7 upkeep=8.3. Low: a new hazardous-waste topic needs fresh content and examples, leaving only3 stable method-diagram points reusable, minus0.7=2.3. Selection, adaptation, complete accuracy checks, delivery and actual notes retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks, laboratory equipment and other teaching materials.

steps.what: Determine actual textbook and laboratory equipment requirements and suitability
inputs: actual curriculum, laboratory needs and equipment constraints
outputs: checked material requirements and selection criteria

steps.what: Select materials by comparing actual current catalog entries against requirements
inputs: checked material requirements and selection criteria
actual current supplier catalog and quotations
outputs: selected materials with checked supplier references

steps.what: Prepare and check the complete material order and supplier destination
inputs: selected materials with checked supplier references
actual quantities, prices and funding code
outputs: final checked material order and supplier destination

steps.what: Review the final material order under the existing budget approval route
inputs: final checked material order and supplier destination
outputs: approval of exact final material order and destination

steps.what: Send the approved final material order to the actual supplier
inputs: final checked material order and supplier destination
approval of exact final material order and destination
outputs: actual supplier order submission

steps.what: Obtain and inspect actual delivered textbooks and laboratory equipment
inputs: actual delivered materials
actual supplier order submission
outputs: actual checked receipt and discrepancies

steps.what: Record and check actual receipts and discrepancies in the purchasing record
inputs: actual checked receipt and discrepancies
outputs: checked saved receipt record

tasks.design: Configure current catalog comparisons and reuse of selected supplier fields in {PROCUREMENT}. Keep suitability decisions, full order checks, the existing budget approval, actual supplier submission, physical receipt and fresh receipt recording.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalog navigation and re-entry of selected order fields can repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalog views and order-field reuse can remove specific preparation work.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment compatibility and learning suitability require actual assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher rejects equipment that fails the laboratory's real teaching needs.
tasks.altitude: Reduce catalog navigation and repeated order fields.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalog views and reuse of supplier fields can reduce purchasing preparation.

assumptions: Provisional shares: comparison20 removes five navigation points; order20 removes three repeated-field points. Full requirement, order and receipt checks remain. Focal denominator95 excludes the existing budget approver5. Submission1 and ordinary saved receipt work retain all their time.

Actual supplier catalog/quote supplies item id, revision, price and availability; teacher supplies actual quantities, compatibility and funding requirements. Missing or incompatible fields require manual work. No credit for existing reuse. Existing budget approval is conditional on this actual purchasing route; do not invent an extra reviewer.
unknowns: Which catalogs and ordering fields already populate automatically?
research_questions: Do catalog references preserve the correct edition and laboratory specification?

incremental.description: Maintain supplier field mappings and current catalog comparisons.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final material order and supplier destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes8 points from95 focal points, less1 upkeep=7.42, capped7.4. Low: new laboratory apparatus requires fresh suitability comparison, leaving1 catalog-navigation point and2 order-field points removable;3/95*100-1=2.16, capped2.1. Selection, approval, send, receipt and fresh records retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write letters of recommendation for students.

steps.what: Assess actual student work and choose substantiated recommendation facts and judgements
inputs: actual student request and permitted records
teacher's actual observations and assessment
outputs: checked student facts, teacher judgements and actual recipient requirements

steps.what: Write a recommendation letter draft from actual checked facts and teacher judgements
inputs: checked student facts, teacher judgements and actual recipient requirements
outputs: complete recommendation letter draft

loop.purpose: Draft recommendation prose without choosing the recommendation
loop.input: actual verified student facts, teacher judgements and recipient requirements
loop.output: complete source-linked letter draft with unsupported claims omitted
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, missing qualifications, attribution, invented comparisons and whether every personal judgement is actually theirs
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns affected prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native letter fields first; individual evidence and qualifications need semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Check the complete generated letter and authorize its exact recipient and final release
inputs: complete recommendation letter draft
checked student facts, teacher judgements and actual recipient requirements
outputs: checked final letter and actual recipient authorized for release

steps.what: Send the final checked recommendation letter to the authorized actual recipient
inputs: checked final letter and actual recipient authorized for release
outputs: actual delivered recommendation letter

tasks.design: Use permitted actual evidence and teacher-chosen judgements to draft letter prose in {DOCS}. Retain full student assessment and the teacher's existing final check of the tool-proposed letter before its actual external release; ordinary internal saving is ungated and receives no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Letter prose is typed repeatedly around individual evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded evidence-grounded drafting can reduce prose typing.
tasks.still_hard: A credible personal recommendation requires the teacher's own assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes firsthand knowledge from an unsupported positive claim.
tasks.altitude: Less prose typing with the recommendation retained by its accountable teacher.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: evidence-grounded letter drafting can assist prose while personal assessment and final release checks remain human.

assumptions: Provisional drafting35 removes seven prose-typing points after retained review; assessment40 and final whole-letter check24 remain. External send1 retains its time. Final check concerns the complete tool-proposed letter and actual external release, not a separate approval of the author's ordinary internal save.

Teacher supplies actual permitted student records, observed achievements, own judgements and recipient requirements; absent claims are omitted or verified manually. Confirm actual source access and recipient before processing. No invented rankings, student consent ceremony, independent reviewer or extra approval job. Existing templates/drafting receive zero new credit.
unknowns: What student evidence may be used in the actual letter route?
research_questions: Can a draft preserve limited firsthand knowledge without adding unsupported comparisons?

incremental.description: Maintain permitted evidence handling and check letter claims against actual sources.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact checked final letter and actual recipient; edits or recipient changes void release authorization

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes7 prose-typing points minus0.8 upkeep=6.2. Low: a student with unusual circumstances needs fresh personal wording, leaving only2 routine descriptive typing points removable, minus0.8=1.2. Assessment, complete claim checks and actual external sending retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce preparation and descriptive typing while retaining scientific teaching and personal assessment.
skills_to_grow: Maintain current subject sources and reusable lecture sections
Check drafting against actual scientific evidence and student observations
role.ambitious_version: Reuse verified teaching and purchasing context without inferring scientific or student judgements.
